2027.name: &Beyond Sossusvlei Desert Lodge
2027.note: andBeyond Lodge Rates 2027 – Namibia STO20, "Accommodation Rate Sheet, Namibia (STO20)", dated 2026/03/04 on the sheet; valid 11 Jan 2027 – 10 Jan 2028 (01–10 Jan 2027 is on the 2026 sheet); Namibian Dollars (NAD), inclusive of VAT. The sheet prints a RACK rate, an STO rate (1–5 nights) and STO Long Stay rates (6+ and 8+ nights, not valid Jul–Aug); all loaded as printed, nothing derived. STO is 20% off rack (sheet title STO20); long-stay 6+ nights = STO less 10%, 8+ nights = STO less 15% (observed on the sheet). Rates are per person per night sharing; the Star Dune Suite (2 rooms + private lounge and dining area, max 4 adults OR 2 adults + 2 children, 3 children on request at extra cost) is per suite per night. Includes: accommodation, three meals daily, soft drinks, house wines, local brand spirits and beers, teas and coffees, refreshments on scenic nature drives, laundry, emergency medical evacuation cover, VAT, airstrip transfers, Guides' Journal and area map, one pair of Swarovski binoculars per room; activities included: one morning Sossusvlei excursion, Living Dunes Experience, Desert People Experience, Desert Rock Experience, Desert Drive, Big Dune Walk, Stargazing, self-exploration e-biking and hiking (guided, subject to availability). Excludes: telephone calls, Safari Shop purchases, gratuities, personal items, champagne, cognacs, fine wines, premium spirits, cigars, Healing Earth wellness treatments. Long Stay rates may combine &Beyond lodges in Africa for the same guests on one itinerary; not combinable with other offers including Signature Offers. Single supplement 50%: 11 Jan – 30 Apr and 01 Nov – 20 Dec 2027 charged only from the third single room per booking; 01 May – 31 Oct 2027 and 21 Dec 2027 – 10 Jan 2028 on all single rooms; charged when an adult shares with an infant. Triple rooms: max 2 adults + 1 child 16 or younger (1 triple in the Suites, Star Dune on request). Child policy: 0–2 free (cots subject to availability); 3–5 free (triple rooms subject to availability); 6–16 sharing with 1–2 adults 50% of adult rate; 6–16 in own room 1st child adult rate, 2nd and 3rd child 50% (max 3 children per room); 17+ adult rate; nature drives 6–12 at manager's discretion, walks 12+. Childminders NAD 125 per child per hour, paid at the lodge. Private vehicle NAD 14,333 per vehicle per night (14h00 arrival to 11h00 departure), all ages. Pilots/local driver-guides: 1 Village Guide room (twin sharing, single subject to availability, guide needs own transport to the main lodge for meals) and 1 Lodge Pilot/Guide room (single basis) at NAD 1,145 per night, accommodation, meals, teas and coffees only — one rate column printed, so rack = net. Tour Leader rate (bona fide tour leaders, max 1 per 14 guests, normal inclusions): Suites NAD 15,290 High / 9,133 Mid for 1–14 guests, 15+ guests 1 x no charge; not offered on the Star Dune Suite — one column printed, so rack = net. The Soar over Sossusvlei private-flight upgrades (NAD 3,100 / 9,200 / 21,400 pp) are loaded under Extras at the printed price; the sheet states all rates are nett/non-commissionable, so they are loaded with rack = net — confirm with &Beyond. Drones not allowed. &Beyond Trading Terms apply. Index of changes: accommodation rates increased, childminder rate increased, offer validity dates updated. This STO doc holds the net STO and STO Long Stay rates only.
